label: 弦影潛入

request.prompt: Muted violins hold thin close minor-second suspensions above a deep bowed cello pedal. Slow low-string pulses under long uneasy high-string notes, restrained dissonant chamber strings, a soft tightening spiral of tension, no lyrical string melody and no jump-scare accents. Pure instrumental psychological horror chamber score for a dark fantasy visual novel. At night a spider-like intruder silently searches a wooden inn while an unknowing woman walks into danger. Cold invasive dread, claustrophobic suspense, an unseen predator already inside, oppressive unresolved tension. The same music must sustain a companion's persistent foreboding after a forest battle, on the return to the inn. Clearly musical pitched instruments, dark sustained harmonic friction and restrained continuous musical motion. Stay intimate and ominous throughout, maintain presence for all 25 seconds, no ending cadence or empty silence. No cheerful, playful, bouncy or romantic melody, no sentimental lament, no heroic action, no fast battle percussion. No vocals, speech, choir, wind, rain, insects, footsteps, creaks, static, environmental ambience or sound effects.
